site.name: La Nuit Blanche
site.description: Student events for Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG.

home.lede: Evenings, tournaments and events for Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG students. Registrations open here soon.

signInPage.title: Sign in
signInPage.lede: Use your school Microsoft account: Epitech, e-artsup or ISEG.
signInPage.noPassword: There's no password to create here: Microsoft checks your school account.

errors.tenantNotAllowed: Only Epitech, e-artsup and ISEG accounts can sign in. Choose your school Microsoft account, for example name{'@'}epitech.eu.
errors.generic: Sign-in didn't finish. Try again with your school Microsoft account.

link.title: Link an app
link.lede: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app you want to connect to your LNB account.
link.help: Codes last 10 minutes. If yours stopped working, ask the app for a new one.

confirm.title: Link {app}?
confirm.matchCode: Check that {app} shows the same code:
confirm.warning: Only link an app you just started connecting yourself. If someone sent you this code, cancel.

identity.title: Your personal identity
identity.details: First name, last name, school email and school

warden.description: Warden links your Minecraft account with your LNB account.

errors.unknown: No app is waiting for this code. Check the digits, or get a new code from the app.
errors.expired: This code has expired. Get a new one from the app, then enter it here.
errors.used: This code was already used. Get a new one from the app.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait 10 minutes, then enter the code again.
errors.failed: The code couldn’t be checked. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.schoolNotAllowed: This app isn’t open to your school.
errors.invalidRedirect: The link from this app has an address it isn’t allowed to use. Enter the code by hand instead.
errors.accountLimitReached: You've linked as many Minecraft accounts as you can. Unlink one on the Warden page first.
errors.minecraftAccountTaken: This Minecraft account is already linked to an LNB account.
errors.wrongAccount: This code is for another LNB account. Join the server with your own address to get a code for yours.

schoolNotAllowed.title: {app} isn’t open to your school
schoolNotAllowed.lede: {app} is only for {schools} students, and your account is from {school}. The code was refused, so you can close {app}.

warden.slots: This uses your only account slot. | This uses one of your {max} account slots.
warden.identity: Your first name and last initial, shown in-game under your username unless you hide it

warden.title: Warden
warden.lede: Your Minecraft accounts on the LNB server, and the address you join it with.
warden.loadFailed: Your Warden status couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

schoolNotAllowed.title: Warden isn’t open to your school yet
schoolNotAllowed.lede: Warden is only for {schools} students for now.

ban.title: You can’t join the server
ban.appealHint: You can appeal once. An admin will answer here.
ban.appealPending: You appealed on {date}. An admin will answer here.

appeal.title: Appeal your ban
appeal.lede: Explain what happened. You can appeal this ban once.
appeal.label: Your appeal
appeal.placeholder: What happened, and why the ban should be lifted

address.title: Your server address
address.help: Add it as a server in Minecraft. It’s yours alone: anyone who has it can join as you, so keep it to yourself.
address.label: Your server address
address.copyFailed: The address couldn’t be copied. Show it, then copy it by hand.
address.regenerateBody: Your current address stops working right away, and you’re disconnected if you’re playing. Use the new address in Minecraft after this.

accounts.title: Minecraft accounts
accounts.count: {used} out of {max} account linked | {used} out of {max} accounts linked
accounts.neverSeen: Not seen on the server yet
accounts.unlinkBody: Its playtime and sessions are deleted, and it can’t join until it’s linked again. Anyone can then link it to their LNB account.
accounts.howTo: To link another account, join {host} with it. The server gives you a 6-digit code to enter on the link page.
accounts.full: You’ve linked as many accounts as you can. Unlink one to link another.

empty.title: Link your Minecraft account
empty.body: Join {host} in Minecraft. The server gives you a 6-digit code: enter it on the link page, and your account appears here.
empty.limit: You can link {max} account. | You can link {max} accounts.

identity.title: In-game identity
identity.label: Show my name in-game
identity.help: Other players see your first name and initial under your Minecraft name.
identity.hideBody: Other players will only see your Minecraft username. Your name helps people at LNB events know who they’re playing with, and staff still see it.

sessions.title: Recent sessions
sessions.empty: No sessions yet. They show up here after you play.

players.search: Search by name, email or Minecraft username

settings.allowCrackedHelp: Accounts not bought from Mojang. When off, they can’t link or join.

player.siteAdminOnly: Only site admins can change the Warden admin role.

player.loadFailed: This player couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection, then reload the page.

banModal.lede: The ban covers every Minecraft account they’ve linked, and replaces their current ban.
banModal.never: Never ends. Only an admin can lift it.
banModal.pickDate: Pick when the ban ends, in the future.

limitModal.title: Account limit for {name}
limitModal.lede: How many Minecraft accounts this player can link. Accounts already linked stay linked.
